passage.text: 18 lip UKVI English Language Tests: Your Essential Guide to IELTS and PTE If you’re applying for a UK visa—whether to study, work, or settle—you’ll likely need to prove your English proficiency with a Secure English Language Test (SELT). The UK Home Office only accepts SELTs from approved providers. Among the most widely accepted and trusted options are IELTS for UKVI and PTE Academic UKVI. In this guide, we’ll walk you through both tests to help you understand which one aligns best with your visa type and language needs.

passage.text: UK government Secure English Language Tests From 6 April 2015, the UK government made changes to the list of qualifications it considers Secure English Language Tests (SELTs) for visa purposes. Studying at a UK university For degree-level study on a Student visa you need English at CEFR B2. You can prove it with a SELT, but a university that is a Higher Education Provider may also assess your English itself. This is why universities can accept tests that are not SELTs, such as TOEFL iBT, the Duolingo English Test or Cambridge C1 Advanced. For study below degree level, the requirement is B1 and a SELT is normally needed. Always check your university's list.

contradictions.topic: Breadth of acceptance IELTS vs PTE

statements.text: IELTS is accepted by over 13,500 organisations while only around 3,000 accept PTE.
IELTS is claimed to be favoured over PTE by most.
PTE Academic UKVI is a fully computer-based test approved by UKVI.

contradictions.assessment: IDP says IELTS is accepted more widely; IRO and Sheffield list both as approved. IDP co-owns IELTS and gives unsourced figures, so treat as biased; for UK visas both are approved SELTs.

uncertainties.text: IELTS result turnaround not covered by any source
uncertainties.howToResolve: Check IELTS/IDP/British Council official result times

uncertainties.text: Which tests your specific university accepts
uncertainties.howToResolve: Check the university's English requirements page

scores.rationale: Often within 48 hours; 85.7% within 2 days in 2018 (Pearson, dated)
Approved SELT, accepted for UK study
Approved SELT; vendor claims broader acceptance (IDP, biased)
LanguageCert is a SELT; TOEFL/Duolingo not SELTs and university-dependent

recommendation.headline: PTE Academic UKVI for speed, if your university accepts it
recommendation.summary: PTE Academic UKVI is the only option with sourced fast turnaround and is an approved SELT; IELTS for UKVI may be marginally wider in acceptance per a biased source.

tradeoffs.text: IDP claims IELTS has wider acceptance, but it co-owns IELTS

alternatives.when: Your university or preference favours IELTS, or you want paper format

caveats: No source gives IELTS turnaround times
